subject: OPEN statement
notes: kb/Work PB318 LANDED (wave 56). RULE (cite.py --check 14.9.27.3 'The OPEN statement for a report file shall not contain the INPUT phrase or the I-O phrase' -> OK 14.9.27.3 1)); corroborated from the file's side by 13.18.46.3 SR3 (cite.py --check 13.18.46.3 'may be referenced in the procedure division only by the USE statement' -> OK 13.18.46.3 3)). StatementValidation.CheckOpenModeForFile, called per file-name from BindOpen with THAT group's mode, reports COBOL2371 open-report-file-mode when FileModel.IsReportFile (the one spelling of 'an FD with a REPORT clause') meets INPUT or I-O. MEASURED (w56a/probe/rpt1.cob): OPEN INPUT and OPEN I-O of a report file rejected at 85 and 2023; OPEN OUTPUT / OPEN EXTEND of the same file accepted (witness: 2023/pb326_ec_report_file_mode ARM 3). That golden's former ARM 2 opened its report file INPUT — non-conforming source under this rule — and was removed in the same change set. Edition-invariant: the report writer and the rule exist at every edition.
